description: This file defines the Java interface 'SearchReadPlatformService' which declares methods for retrieving search data and queries related to portfolio search functionalities within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SearchReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface for platform services related to searching portfolio data, providing methods to retrieve matching data and query templates.

methods.name: retriveMatchingData
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SearchData objects that match the given search conditions.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQueryTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for ad-hoc search queries.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQueryMatchingData
methods.description: Retrieves a list of AdHocSearchQueryData objects that match the specified ad-hoc search conditions.
